tools.name: list_states
tools.description: States and cities with a daily liquor license feed, how often each one updates, and each state's page.

tools.name: find_license
tools.description: Look up one business by name in a state's liquor license filings: its license type, status, place and date. Sorted by name; address and contacts are on the paid feed.

tools.name: county_activity
tools.description: New liquor license filings in one county in the last 30 days, with its most common license types and cities, and how many were changes of ownership.

tools.name: license_timing
tools.description: How long a liquor license takes in a state, measured from filings followed through to the issued license.

tools.name: sample_filings
tools.description: Up to 25 filings from one state, at least a week old, without phones or owners, with filed_from and filed_to dates, to show what the feed contains.

tools.name: plans
tools.description: Liquor License Feed plans, prices and trial terms.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "sample_filings" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Up to 25 filings from one state, from a full week at least a week back, without phones or owners, to show what the feed contains." → after: "Up to 25 filings from one state, at least a week old, without phones or owners, with filed_from and filed_to dates, to show what the feed contains."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
